newsitem.title: BELGIUM: French Edap seeks Easdaq listing - paper.
newsitem.headline: French Edap seeks Easdaq listing - paper.

text.p: French Edap TMS SA, a French medical equipment manufacturer, has applied for a listing on Brussels-based pan-European growth stock market Easdaq, Belgian daily De Standaard said on Tuesday.
An Easdaq spokeswoman declined to comment on the report.
EDAP, based in Vaulx-en-Velin, France, develops, produces, markets and distributes minimally-invasive medical devices, primarily for the treatment of urological diseases.
On Monday, it filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission an initial public offering to sell up to four million American Depositary Shares on Nasdaq.
The initial price is estimated to be between $9 and $11 per ADS, Edap said in the filing.

Net proceeds will be used to fund research and development of high-intensity focused ultrasound technology products and the Prostatron, a medical device using transurethral microwave thermotherapy, the company said.
